messages:
maya: Quick note — the hello-lite quickstart still references AUTH_TOKEN in .env but our SDK now expects REDWOOD_API_KEY. Also the image link in README 404s. Small follow-up PR?

sam: Can you point me to the exact file? I can open a PR.

maya: sources/quickstarts/hello-lite/README.md lines ~24 and ~72. Replace AUTH_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY. Link currently points to /docs/assets/hello-screenshot.png which was moved to /assets/images/hello-lite.png

sam: Thanks. Quick patch I'd run locally: `sed -n '1,120p' README.md` and change env var + link. Want me to also add a short migration note about the env var name change?

liam: :eyes: FYI linkcheck failed in last docs build — failing on that path. CI log:

````
ERROR: 404 /docs/assets/hello-screenshot.png
````

I can re-run once PR is up.

devex-sam: please add a tiny Python SDK v2 snippet showing REDWOOD_API_KEY usage. Example:

```python
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
print(client.generate('hello'))
```

olivia: I'll open the PR in a minute. Will rename var, fix link, add migration note and the Python snippet. Tagging @maya for review.

maya: Perfect. Small nit: use `os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']` in the snippet or `os.getenv`? prefer `getenv` with default None in quickstarts.

olivia: Used `getenv` and included a comment about env loading. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — CI shows linkcheck failed before my fix but now green on lint. Assigning to maya.

ci-bot: Build passed. Linkcheck: 1 broken link fixed. Deployed preview available: https://deploy-preview--docs.redwood.dev/hello-lite

maya: Looks good. Please cherry-pick to release/2026-03 branch for the upcoming patch. :shipit:
